title: HardSpec
description: The hardener's output: a DAG of atomic, sized, independent tasks derived from an informal spec.

source_spec_ref.description: pointer/hash of the informal hand-written spec this was hardened from

edges.description: dependency DAG edges; MUST be acyclic

from.description: task id that must complete first

invariants_checked.description: hardener self-check results; all must be true to hand off

total_mutation_budget.description: sum of per-task budgets; the CPU envelope stage 4 schedules within
